title: Lemma 3.1: elementary objects under an unramified pregeometry pushout
statement_scope: Let f: T -> T' be a map of pregeometries which is unramified, let X be an infinity-topos, and let sigma be an object of Str^loc_T(X) whose image under the pullback g^* along the pushout square is compared by an effective epimorphism beta admitting a section. Then the comparison morphism in Str^loc_T'(X) is an equivalence on the relevant elementary objects; the proof passes to Spec_T and uses the unramifiedness criterion.
